choices.text: Nee, wanneer u afsloeg naar de zijstraat verliest u het voorrangsrecht van B15a; u moet voorrang verlenen aan voertuigen die al op de zijstraat rijden
Ja, zolang u bord B15a gepasseerd bent, heeft u overal voorrang op dat kruispunt

EN.question: Sign B15a is on your road. You want to turn into a side street. Do you still have priority over traffic coming from that side street?

choices.text: No, when you turn into the side street you lose the B15a right of way; you must give way to vehicles already on the side street
Yes, as long as you passed sign B15a, you have priority everywhere at that junction

EN.explanation: The right of way of B15a only applies while you are on the main road. Once you enter the side street, normal priority rules for that side street apply.
